leaves.name: degHomogPoly
leaves.doc: Mumford, Abelian varieties (1970), section 19 (locator UNVERIFIED; the statement used in the proof of 19 Thm 4): deg is a homogeneous polynomial function of degree 2g on End(X), X an abelian variety of dimension g over an algebraically closed field. Read in coordinates: for every finite family e_1..e_r in End(A) there is a homogeneous N in Q[x_1..x_r] of degree 2 dim A with degEnd(sum x_i e_i) = N(x) for all x in Z^r; degEnd is the genuine function-field degree (0 for non-isogenies).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (Mumford 19: deg is a homogeneous polynomial function of degree 2g on End X, from the theorem of the cube and Riemann-Roch); locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Mumford, Abelian varieties, section 19 (deg is a homogeneous polynomial function of degree 2g on End(X)); also Milne, Abelian varieties (2008), section 12

note: deg-det: charPolyIndepOfEllAlgClosed (via charpoly-ell's DegEqDetTate, Mumford 19 Thm 4) from ONE printed leaf degHomogPoly (deg is a homogeneous polynomial function of degree 2g on End(A); Mumford 19) and the bundle's own fields mumfordTorsionAlgClosed and homFreeFiniteAlgClosed. Proved in Lean: the algebra of Mumford's proof of 19 Thm 4 (Nullstellensatz extension of a multiplicative polynomial function on Z[phi], det F(M) = prod F(roots), one-sided l-adic comparison lemma), deg(psi chi) = deg psi deg chi (tower law), |det T_l psi|_l = |#ker psi|_l for any endomorphism with finite kernel (Smith normal form over Z_l), #ker psi(kbar) | deg psi (translations by the kernel act faithfully on K(A) fixing psi^*K(A); Artin), rank V_l = 2g. Net count: -1 field +1 leaf, no glue (strict 34/11 -> 34/11), the same count as charpoly-ell's fold, with Mumford 19 Thm 4 replaced by its one deep input. Report docs/research/deg-det.md.
